title: Concordia Reputation Attestation
description: A signed, structured record of negotiation behavior and outcome. Produced automatically from every Concordia session transcript. Attestations are the raw material of trust; they record what happened without computing scores. Scoring is performed by external reputation services that consume attestations. v0.6 follows draft-newton-agreement-evidence-00 with a closed member set.

concordia_attestation.description: Attestation schema version (semver). Matches the protocol version.

attestation_id.description: Unique identifier for this attestation. Recommended format: 'att_' followed by a UUID v4.

session_id.description: The negotiation session this attestation records.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of attestation generation.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock time from session open to conclusion.

terms_count.description: Number of terms in the negotiation.

resolution_mechanism.description: How agreement was reached (or 'none' if not reached).

parties.description: Behavioral record for each party in the negotiation.

role.description: The agent's role in this negotiation.

behavior.description: Quantified behavioral signals derived from the transcript.

offers_made.description: Number of offers and counteroffers submitted.

concessions.description: Number of times the agent moved toward the counterparty's position.

concession_magnitude.description: Average concession size as a fraction of the term's range. 0.0 = no movement; 1.0 = full concession to counterparty's position.

signals_shared.description: Number of voluntary preference signals shared (§3.4).

constraints_violated.description: Number of own constraints the agent later contradicted. A strong indicator of bad-faith negotiation.

reasoning_provided.description: Whether the agent used the reasoning field in any message.

withdrawal.description: Whether the agent withdrew from the negotiation.

response_time_avg_seconds.description: Average time to respond to counterparty messages.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over this party's behavioral record, confirming accuracy.

meta.description: Contextual metadata. Reveals the type of negotiation without exposing deal specifics.

category.description: Dot-separated lowercase taxonomy path (e.g., 'electronics.cameras'), max 64 chars. Free text is rejected so raw deal terms cannot ride in it (SPEC 9.6.6). MAY be omitted for privacy.

value_range.description: Logarithmic value bucket from the fixed enumerated vocabulary, suffixed with a 3-letter uppercase currency code (e.g., '1000-5000_USD'). The bands are enumerated rather than free-form so an exact price cannot be encoded as a degenerate range (SPEC 9.6.6). Preserves privacy while enabling size-weighted scoring.

extensions_used.description: Protocol extensions active in this session.

transcript_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete negotiation transcript. Allows independent verification.

chain_head.description: v0.3.0 receipt set-binding: SHA-256 message hash (§9.3) of the final transcript message, including its signature. With prev_hash links, this pins the chain head inside the countersigned issuance snapshot. Required by verifiers for concordia_attestation >= 0.3.0.

message_count.description: v0.3.0 receipt set-binding: number of messages in the transcript. Closes truncation when paired with chain_head. Required by verifiers for concordia_attestation >= 0.3.0.

summary.description: Plaintext receipt summary generated from behavioral metadata and transcript hash prefix. Structured raw term fields are rejected by this schema. This free-text field is a behavioral-signal summary and, by caller contract, MUST NOT contain raw deal terms; validators apply best-effort checks for obvious raw-term patterns as defense in depth.

fulfillment.description: Legacy pre-0.6 root fulfillment block. Undefined for 0.6.0 and later agreement attestations.

references.description: Generalized references to other signed artifacts (receipts or CMPC primitives) that this attestation relates to. Capped at 32 entries (SPEC §11.5.8). Added in v0.4.0 (WP2). Forward-compatible with CMPC v0.5 primitive types.

validity_temporal.description: Temporal validity window for the attestation. Required for concordia_attestation 0.5.0 and later; legacy artifacts remain readable under version-gated verifier rules. Added in v0.4.0 (WP3).

countersignatures.description: Map of party agent_id to base64url-padded Ed25519 signature over canonical_json(strip_signatures(attestation minus countersignatures)).

fulfillment_attestation.description: Records whether the agreed terms were actually honored after settlement.

status.description: Fulfillment outcome. v0.4.1 adds 'fulfilled_with_mediation' for outcomes that close via an A2CN DISPUTE_RESOLVED message (A2CN PR #12).

fulfilled_at.description: When fulfillment was confirmed. Null if not yet fulfilled.

description.description: Brief behavioral description of the dispute. Structured raw term fields are rejected by this schema. This free-text field, by caller contract, MUST NOT contain raw deal terms; validators apply best-effort checks for obvious raw-term patterns as defense in depth.

disputes.description: Disputes raised about specific terms. Empty array if no disputes.

counterparty_attestation.description: The counterparty's confirmation of fulfillment. Mutual attestation creates stronger trust signals.

notes.description: Optional brief behavioral note about the experience. Structured raw term fields are rejected by this schema. This free-text field, by caller contract, MUST NOT contain raw deal terms; validators apply best-effort checks for obvious raw-term patterns as defense in depth.

reference.description: A generalized reference to another signed artifact. Introduced in v0.4.0 (WP2); ratified by v0.5 (SPEC §11.5). Mirrors schemas/reference.schema.json. The full semantics, including layering boundary against envelope-level references, are specified in SPEC §11.5.

id.description: Identifier of the referenced artifact. URN-shaped where possible (SPEC §11.5.7). Max 256 chars, whitespace-free so prose deal terms cannot ride in identifier fields (SPEC §9.6.6).

type.description: Kind of artifact referenced. Canonical emit vocabulary is receipt, chain_session, predicate, mandate. Read-side validators accept non-empty whitespace-free strings of at most 64 chars and preserve unknown values per SPEC §11.5.5 and §11.5.8.

relationship.description: Semantic relationship per SPEC §11.5.5. Canonical emit vocabulary is supersedes, extends, fulfills, references. Read-side validators accept non-empty whitespace-free strings of at most 64 chars and preserve unknown values per SPEC §11.5.8.

version.description: Optional. Version of the referenced artifact when known. Whitespace-free, max 256 chars.

signed_at.description: Optional. Timestamp of the referenced artifact's signature when known. Whitespace-free, max 256 chars.

signer_did.description: Optional. DID of the signer of the referenced artifact when known. Whitespace-free, max 256 chars.

oneOf.description: Absolute clock-bounded validity. Added in v0.4.0 (WP3).
Validity is N seconds after the anchor timestamp. Added in v0.4.0 (WP3).

reputation_query.description: Standard format for querying an agent's reputation from a reputation service.

reputation_response.description: Standard response format from a reputation service. The protocol defines the shape; services define the scoring.

service_id.description: Identifier of the reputation service providing this response.

confidence.description: How confident the service is in this score. Low confidence = few attestations.

agreement_rate.description: Fraction of negotiations that reached agreement.

fulfillment_rate.description: Fraction of agreements that were fulfilled.

reasoning_rate.description: Fraction of negotiations where reasoning was provided.

median_rounds_to_agreement.description: Median number of rounds in successful negotiations.

categories_active.description: Categories this agent has negotiated in.

context_specific.description: Scores filtered to the query context (category, value range, role).

flags.description: Notable flags. Both positive and negative signals.

service_signature.description: Ed25519 signature from the reputation service, creating accountability for the scoring.
